intro: We list {{count}} MBA / PGDM colleges in Maharashtra where our records show a highest package of at least ₹{{threshold}} lakh. {{published}} of them have a published profile, mostly in Mumbai and Pune.

These MBA colleges in Maharashtra with ₹15 lakh highest package include IIM Mumbai, SIBM Pune, IIT Bombay, SPJIMR and JBIMS. They anchor the top MBA colleges in Maharashtra 2026 on this measure, with a long tail of private schools after them.
listLead: Ranked colleges appear first, then the rest by recorded package. Read the programme name: some cards show an executive MBA, a healthcare MBA or a weak row that does not match the flagship course.
snapshot: Across the published colleges here, the median recorded average package is {{pkgMedian}}, from placement years {{pkgYearMin}} to {{pkgYearMax}}.
Recorded averages run from {{pkgMin}} to {{pkgMax}}. The highest single figure we hold is {{highestMax}}, on JBIMS's MMS Finance row for 2024.
Most colleges are private ({{private}}), with {{public}} public institutes. CAT, ATMA, SNAP and MAH MBA CET are the exams most often linked to this list.
firstCollegesLead: In the official NIRF 2025 Management ranking, IIM Mumbai is 6th, SIBM Pune is 11th, IIT Bombay is 14th, SPJIMR is 20th, NMIMS is 24th, IIM Nagpur is 25th and KJ Somaiya is 65th.

SPJIMR's 2024 PGDM Finance row shows an average of ₹33 LPA and a highest of ₹81 LPA in our records. Ignore the JBIMS MHRD card that shows ₹1 LPA and ₹4 LPA; the MMS Finance row for 2024 shows ₹26 LPA and ₹87 LPA.

sections.heading: How this ₹15 lakh list relates to the tighter Maharashtra cuts
paragraphs: The sister articles with ₹30 lakh and ₹50 lakh cuts are shorter subsets of this list. A college can appear here on an older year or a specialised programme, and then drop off the tighter lists.
Two colleges on this page are unpublished in our file. Placement years as early as {{pkgYearMin}} also appear, and those rows should be replaced by the latest official report.

compare.heading: How to compare MBA colleges in Maharashtra with ₹15 lakh highest package
paragraphs: With {{count}} colleges, the highest-package cut is only a first filter. Use the average, the year, the official rank and the programme to narrow the list.
bullets: The official NIRF 2025 Management ranks for the well-known Mumbai and Pune schools.
Whether the fee and the placement figure belong to the same programme.
The entrance test — CAT, SNAP, MAH MBA CET, NMAT or XAT — and the current cut-off.
The latest official placement report, especially where our year is before 2022.

faqs.question: Which MBA colleges in Maharashtra with ₹15 lakh highest package are listed here?
faqs.answer: {{count}} colleges, of which {{published}} are published. Most are in Mumbai or Pune, and the list includes IIM Mumbai, SIBM Pune, IIT Bombay, SPJIMR, JBIMS and IIM Nagpur.

faqs.question: What average packages do these colleges report?
faqs.answer: The median recorded average is {{pkgMedian}}, with recorded averages from {{pkgMin}} to {{pkgMax}}. Some cards have a highest-package figure but no usable average, so read each row in full.

faqs.question: What are the official NIRF 2025 ranks for the leading colleges?
faqs.answer: IIM Mumbai is 6th, SIBM Pune is 11th, IIT Bombay is 14th, SPJIMR is 20th, NMIMS is 24th, IIM Nagpur is 25th and KJ Somaiya is 65th in the official NIRF 2025 Management ranking.

faqs.question: Why does one JBIMS card show a ₹1 Lakh average?
faqs.answer: That MHRD row looks wrong. The MMS Finance row for 2024 in our file shows an average of ₹26 LPA and a highest of ₹87 LPA. Confirm the official JBIMS report.

faqs.question: Are packages from 2015 or 2017 still useful?
faqs.answer: Only as a marker that a college once met this threshold in our file. Replace those years with the latest official placement report before you decide.

faqs.question: Why do some well-known colleges show an executive or specialised fee?
faqs.answer: The IIT Bombay card may show an Executive MBA fee of ₹21 lakh, which is not the full-time MBA fee. Always match the fee notice to the programme you will join.
